name: Calibre
description: Calibre is an open-source application for organizing and reading ebook libraries. It provides desktop library management, format conversion, ebook editing, device sync, and an optional browser-accessible Content server.
agentUseSummary: Connect a customer-operated Calibre Content server at one exact public HTTPS origin with a dedicated Basic-auth account, selected library ID, and selected book ID. Relay exposes only the selected book ID, selected library ID, added and modified timestamps, and format count while blocking all private book metadata and content, lists, search, OPDS browsing, downloads, uploads, conversions, edits, deletes, server administration, filesystem access, process control, local execution, and broader access.

credentialRequirements.name: CALIBRE_SERVER_ORIGIN
credentialRequirements.label: Calibre Content server HTTPS origin
credentialRequirements.helpText: One exact public HTTPS origin serving Calibre at the root with Basic authentication enabled; paths, embedded credentials, private hosts, and nonstandard ports are rejected.

credentialRequirements.name: CALIBRE_USERNAME
credentialRequirements.label: Calibre read-only username
credentialRequirements.helpText: A dedicated Calibre Content server user restricted to the selected library and book where supported.

credentialRequirements.name: CALIBRE_PASSWORD
credentialRequirements.label: Calibre password
credentialRequirements.helpText: The dedicated user's password; Relay encrypts it and sends it only through HTTPS Basic authentication to the configured origin.

credentialRequirements.name: CALIBRE_LIBRARY_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Selected library ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: The exact library ID containing the selected book.

credentialRequirements.name: CALIBRE_BOOK_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Selected book ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: The positive numeric ID of the single book Relay may inspect.

capabilities.label: Read selected book lifecycle
capabilities.description: Read only the selected book ID, selected library ID, added and modified timestamps, and format count without title, author, comments, identifiers, tags, cover, files, download URLs, custom metadata, or reading state.

allowed.label: Read selected book lifecycle
allowed.description: Read only the selected book ID, selected library ID, added and modified timestamps, and format count.

blocked.label: Expose private book metadata or content
blocked.description: Titles, authors, comments, identifiers, tags, publishers, languages, series, ratings, custom fields, covers, book files, download URLs, and reading state are excluded.

blocked.label: Mutate Calibre or library state
blocked.description: Uploads, downloads, conversions, metadata edits, deletes, user management, server configuration, process control, filesystem access, and every other mutation are blocked.

blocked.label: Use broad Calibre access
blocked.description: Other books or libraries, lists, categories, search, OPDS browsing, arbitrary paths or queries, redirects, bulk access, and local library discovery are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Read Only
approvalProfiles.description: Read one selected book's lifecycle summary; private metadata, book content, broader access, local execution, and mutations remain blocked.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway stores the encrypted Content server credentials and selected IDs and mounts exactly one fixed-path projected read.
Railway stores the encrypted Content server credentials and selected IDs and mounts exactly one fixed-path projected read.

providerSetup.blocker: A customer-operated Calibre staging Content server at a public root HTTPS origin, Basic-auth mode, dedicated restricted user, and exact library/book IDs are required. No authorized server or credentials are available in this worker lane.
providerSetup.nextAction: The external setup lane must nominate a staging Content server, enable HTTPS and Basic auth, create a dedicated restricted user, capture credentials and selected IDs directly in Railway, then validate the projected read, public-host and fixed-path enforcement, private-field redaction, authentication failure, password rotation, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial in Fairfax.

evidence.supports: Calibre documents the Content server for browser access to libraries, username/password protection for internet access, HTTPS as the maximum-security setup, reverse-proxy deployment, Basic-auth mode under SSL, and user permissions.

Calibre's official source defines GET /ajax/book/{book_id}/{library_id} as a selected-book JSON endpoint and supports category_urls=false; the implementation verifies the requested numeric book and the authenticated user's allowed IDs.

Calibre's official metadata source documents the private and publication fields returned for books, including title, authors, comments, identifiers, tags, timestamps, custom metadata, application ID, and formats; Relay retains only lifecycle timestamps, selected IDs, and a format count.
